# Cncf Huawei Functionstage Reviewer

Review Huawei FunctionStage using its official documentation and repository in the Serverless / Hosted Platform category. FunctionStage is an event-driven function hosting and computing service, that compiles function code and configures running conditions without provisioning or managing servers, thus providing a scalable, maintenance-free, and reliable operation environment for functions. You only pay for what you use.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
